contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #064: Topological triviality of μ-constant surface singularities.
Audit the literal marked monomial reduction and relative log-model propositions in OpenAI Math Family 064, September 24, 2026 manuscript, without adding a mu-constant hypothesis.

definitions.base: a smooth connected complex algebraic curve with a distinguished point 0, after allowed shrinking and finite smooth-curve base change
definitions.target: a flat projective family of integral normal Gorenstein surfaces with normal Gorenstein total space and a section containing all fiber singularities, smooth away from that section
definitions.horizontal_boundary: the coefficient-one sum of all surviving exceptional prime divisors dominating the base

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 064 (Topological triviality of μ-constant surface singularities.; papers: Topological triviality of mu-constant families of surface singularities; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Under the literal hypotheses of prop:log-model, after shrinking and finite smooth-curve base change there is a projective birational model, isomorphic off the section, normal Q-factorial, with every scheme fiber reduced Cartier and (Y,H+Y_c) dlt for EVERY remaining c; K_Y+H is nef over X; vertical exceptional primes are over 0; noncentral fibers are integral normal with reduced H restriction; the central fiber has one component dominating X_0 and all others projective over its section point.

The literal prop:marked-monomial-reduction holds for every smooth quasi-projective complex threefold and reduced horizontal marking satisfying its SNC and punctured-smoothness hypotheses, for every positive common multiple b of the central multiplicities: the normalized s^b=tau base change admits a projective birational smooth modification with reduced SNC central fiber together with the transformed marking, unchanged on all originally smooth relatively SNC opens.

For 1<=k<=3, positive a_i dividing b, N={d in Z^k: sum a_i d_i=0 mod b}, subdivision of the positive orthant at all height-one lattice points yields regular simplicial cones; their vertical primitive generators all have height one. Empty lattice triangles are unimodular by the fundamental-parallelogram reflection argument.

For the literal marked-reduction hypotheses, the congruence-lattice local constructions globalize as normalized blowups of sums of Cartier multiples of globally labeled vertical order-vector divisors. They preserve horizontal product coordinates, introduce no horizontal exceptional primes, and are unchanged on the stipulated smooth opens; the regular local fans yield a smooth global source with simple rather than self-intersecting normal crossings boundary.

Assuming characteristic-zero supported projective log resolution/principalization, the log-model hypotheses admit a smooth resolved threefold with all vertical exceptional divisors over 0 after shrinking, and the prescribed finite root cover leaves the target normal Gorenstein integral with integral surface fibers; marked monomial reduction gives an SNC input (V,H_V+V_c) at EVERY remaining parameter, isomorphic off the section.

The SNC marked input V->X admits a finite (K_V+H_V)-MMP over the BIRATIONAL TARGET X, with divisorial contractions and flips only, preserving Q-factoriality and the standard dlt discrepancy inequalities for any boundary making these same steps negative, extracting no divisors, and ending with a nef model or Mori fiber space.

CONDITIONAL on the explicitly stated relative MMP input for the smooth marked semistable V->X, its output satisfies ALL four guarantees of prop:log-model simultaneously, including reduced Cartier scheme fibers and dlt(Y,H+Y_c) for every remaining c, full coefficient-one surviving horizontal marking, nefness over X, and no modification outside the section.

For coefficients (2,2,3) and exponent 6, the normalized vertical orthant has lattice index 6 and initial cone index 3. Inserting rays (2,1,0) then (1,2,0) gives exactly three unimodular cones, each with vertical height one. This is one exact local calculation, not a counterexample or verification of prop:log-model.

Assuming characteristic-zero supported projective log resolution/principalization, the log-model hypotheses admit a smooth resolved threefold with all vertical exceptional divisors over 0 after shrinking, and the prescribed finite root cover leaves the target normal Gorenstein integral with integral surface fibers; marked monomial reduction gives an SNC input (V,H_V+V_c) at EVERY remaining parameter, isomorphic off the section.

claims.natural_statement: Manuscript thm:main: every holomorphic family F in three variables with isolated critical point at the origin on each parameter fiber, F(0,t)=0 and constant finite Milnor number admits, after shrinking, a jointly continuous parameter-preserving ambient homeomorphism Phi(x,t)=(phi_t(x),t), with phi_0=id, phi_t(0)=0, f_t(phi_t(x))=f_0(x), and jointly continuous inverse over the ORIGINAL disk.

Unverified manuscript numerical bridge: in the non-log-canonical mu-constant surface case the marked model, full exceptional-boundary identification, Euler comparison and logarithmic surface inequality force vanishing of the extra component log canonical squares and constancy of the Wahl invariant.

Unverified manuscript resolution and lifting bridge: Wahl-invariant constancy in the non-log-canonical Gorenstein case yields the required simultaneous resolutions; transport lifts to ambient function-level right-triviality, jointly with its inverse, and finite parameter covers can be removed over the original disk.

Unverified manuscript complementary branch: the log-canonical and low-multiplicity mu-constant surface cases supply the same jointly ambient right-trivial conclusion without relying on the non-log-canonical Wahl-invariant bridge.
